_comment_forumChatId: Telegram supergroup (forum) chat id the bridge posts topics into
_comment_allowedUserIds: Telegram user ids allowed to interact with the bridge
_comment_defaultCwd: Default working directory for new sessions when no project is specified
_comment_projects: Named shortcuts mapping a project name to a working directory
_comment_editIntervalMs: Minimum interval between message edits while streaming a response (default 1500)
_comment_showThoughts: Whether to forward the agent's thinking/reasoning blocks to Telegram (default false)
_comment_adapterCommand: Command used to spawn the ACP adapter process (default ["npx", "-y", "claude-agent-acp"])
_comment_adapterEnv: Extra environment variables passed to the adapter process
_comment_dataDir: Directory used to persist bridge state (default ~/.local/share/telegram-acp-bridge)
